title: DHIS2 Working List
description: A composable React 18 Working List block for DHIS2 tracker programs.
docs: Render WorkingList beneath the DHIS2 app-runtime and TanStack Query providers. Compose WorkingListViewSwitcher, WorkingListToolbar with its column/filter/action controls, and WorkingListTable. View selection and pagination work uncontrolled by default or as independent controlled value/callback pairs. A controlled page is kept on mount, so a deep link opens on it; onDirtyChange reports unsaved changes. Inside WorkingList, useWorkingList holds the client state (viewId, draft, pagination and their setters); useWorkingListMetadata, useSavedLists, useWorkingListView and useWorkingListRecords return query results to branch on with isPending and isError; useCreateSavedList, useUpdateSavedList, useDeleteSavedList and useRepairSavedList are TanStack mutations. For a calendar view, install calendar alongside working-list and follow the tested composition at /blocks/working-list#calendar-view: useWorkingListDateBounds and useWorkingListDateRange supply the date window, and getWorkingListRecordStatus resolves tracker statuses without depending on Calendar. There is no separate working-list-calendar block.
